summary: Both user requests implemented. (1) Markers are now hollow: the selected annotation color strokes the capsule outline and numeral, interior stays transparent so the underlying image shows through; applies uniformly to placed markers, the cursor preview (shared drawMarker), and the inline renumber editor (textColor = item.color). The obsolete markerContentColor contrast helper was removed; NSColor.isLight kept (still used by the palette number label). (2) Annotation creation sizing now freezes at the ACTUAL initial scrollView.magnification (baseScale × userZoomFactor, incl. fit downscale and Retina point↔pixel conversion) captured after applyZoom in sizeWindowToImage — so new text and markers render ~38.4 screen points on both small captures and full-screen images. Manual zoom afterwards does not change subsequently created sizes (textCreationZoomFactor is set once per session). defaultTextFontSize is now capped at ImageSafetyLimits.runtime.maxFontSize (2000) so extreme downscale fits can't produce unsafe saved sizes. Cursor preview still matches placed bounds via live magnification (previous fix untouched). 258/258 tests pass.
findings: Root cause of the tiny-marker bug: sizeWindowToImage passed only defaultUserZoomFactor to setInitialTextZoomFactor; on full-screen captures baseScale (= fitScale × pointToCanvasScale ≈ availPixels/imagePixels) was dropped, so a marker sized 38.4 canvas units displayed at ~6-10 screen points.

baseScale simplifies to availableContentPixels/imagePixels — independent of window backing factor — which is why passing scrollView.magnification (post-applyZoom effective value) is exactly correct regardless of Retina conversion.
maxFontSize clamp matters: at magnification < 0.0192 the raw 38.4/mag exceeds the 2000 persisted-state limit; without the clamp, saved marker/text state could fail isSafeToRestore on reload.

markerContentColor is fully removed — after hollow rendering its only caller (beginEditingMarker) now uses item.color directly. isLight survives (EditorWindowController.swift:542 palette label contrast).
Marker geometry unchanged: markerRect/markerBounds/outline width identical — only the fill was removed; hit-testing, selection outline, and cursor-preview size math all still apply.

drawMarker keeps its isPreview alpha parameter for signature symmetry with the other draw functions; marker call sites pass false (cursor preview renders the real geometry, just hollow like the placed marker).
Existing saved annotations retain stored sizes: fontSize/diameter are serialized per item; the new creation scale only affects newly created items.
changes: Sources/EditorImageRenderer.swift — drawMarker rewritten hollow: no fill; capsule stroke + numeral use item.color (or 0.7 alpha in preview); markerContentColor helper deleted.
Sources/EditorCanvasView.swift:1316 — inline marker editor textColor = item.color (was markerContentColor).

Sources/EditorWindowController.swift:803-810 — sizeWindowToImage now calls applyZoom() first, then setInitialTextZoomFactor(scrollView.magnification) — freezing creation sizing at the actual initial on-screen scale.
README.md:102 — marker doc updated to hollow/transparent-interior + annotation-colored outline and numeral.

Tests/ZoomiesTests/NumberedMarkerTests.swift — testMarkerRendersFillAndContrastingContent rewritten as testMarkerRendersTransparentInteriorWithColoredOutlineAndNumeral: asserts interior pixels still show base blue (transparency), numeral and outline ring render in chosen red, corner untouched.

Tests/ZoomiesTests/EditorWindowControllerTests.swift — 3 new tests via real EditorWindowController: small-image invariant (fontSize and marker diameter × live magnification ≈ 38.4, diameter==fontSize), large 4000×2000px image (magnification<0.95, fontSize>38.4, same ≈38.4 invariant, fontSize ≤ maxFontSize), and manual-zoom freeze (Cmd+= changes magnification but not subsequently created sizes). Helpers newTextEditorFontSize (reads fresh text editor's font.pointSize) and placeMarkerAndGetDiameter added.
decisions: Freeze = single write of textCreationZoomFactor from scrollView.magnification after applyZoom, rather than observing magnification — spec says manual zoom must not change creation size, and applyZoom at that point has already resolved clamping/auto-zoom.

Hollow interior implemented by dropping path.fill() — simplest faithful interpretation ('no filled circle/background'); outline stays markerOutlineWidth(diameter) so geometry/bounds/hit-test are unchanged.
Renamed nothing; markerContentColor deleted rather than kept as a pass-through since 'remove obsolete contrast helper if unused' was explicit.
Large-image test builds a real 4000×2000 NSBitmapImageRep (32MB) so imagePixelSize exercises the true downscale path instead of a mocked layout.
fontSize asserted via the fresh inline editor's font.pointSize — that's exactly the creation size applied to new text items.
evidence: Sources/EditorCanvasView.swift:560-566 (font clamp), :1316 (editor color), :1739-1747 (unchanged live-magnification preview sizing).
Baseline diff: only intended files differ; other dirty files (NativeAreaCaptureTests, ScreenshotServiceCoreLogicTests, etc.) match baseline — pre-existing work preserved.

checks.detail: 39 tests, 0 failures; all 3 new sizing tests and the rewritten pixel test pass on first run.

open_issues: At extreme downscale (magnification < ~0.019), creation size clamps at 2000 canvas units, so on-screen size falls short of 38.4pt — unreachable in practice (would need >8K content in a tiny window); stated for completeness.
Inline renumber editor now shows the annotation color on a transparent background — for very light colors on light images legibility mirrors the hollow marker itself.
Visual smoke (hollow marker look + full-screen sizing) pending parent's install/launch.
